_notes: Kit defaults of the paseo-kit harness (loaded by .agents/harness/config.mjs; meaning of every key: docs/INTERFACES.md section 4 of the kit). A project overrides keys in .agents/harness.config.json (the overlay): tiers, tier_aliases, platform_notes, context_guard, io_guard, read_limits, adapter and gsd merge per entry (an overlay entry replaces that whole entry); every other key is replaced whole. Kit-owned keys ignore overlay values: agent_providers, agent_provider_disallowed_tools, agent_provider_env, main_provider_disallowed_tools (machine keys describing the one Paseo config of the machine; kit machine check/apply and ph doctor use them) and first_prompt_note (a project adds its text in project_prompt_note). tiers: frontier = hardest long-horizon planning and coordination, pro = deep reasoning, design, verification and judging, standard = routine work and the default; the kit ships them unconfigured (provider "") and the harness adapter generator or the owner writes the project's mapping into the overlay, for example "tiers": {"standard": {"provider": "circle/gpt-6.1-sol[1m]", "thinking": "low"}, "pro": {"provider": "circle/claude-opus-5-5[1m]", "thinking": "high"}}; features = Paseo agent features set at creation (e.g. fast_mode). allowed_models: empty = any, else ids matched with the provider mapping applied and the [..] suffix stripped. max_subagents 20 running agents (2026-10-04: 30 agents exhausted 32 GB RAM, about 350 MB per agent); max_live_subagents bounds running + idle agents. max_prompt_bytes: an outbound message above it is refused (a 42 MB prompt made the daemon drop the runner socket). agent_nudge_s / agent_stop_s / watchdog_*: workflow watchdog on model time since the last prompt (tool time not counted); 0 disables a limit, watchdog_enabled false arms nothing. read_limits: one read page of the harness-files tools (replyMaxChars <= 40000).
compact_resume: Compaction done. Continue where you left off; re-arm any Monitor you stopped.
first_prompt_note: Read in bulk (one batched read of all needed files, not one small query per item). Batch reads and edits with the harness-files mod tools (read_ranges, edit_multiple_files, write_multiple_files) when they are enabled, otherwise use native Read/Edit/Write where owner restrictions permit. Scripts that write files must use UTF-8. Never send messages to the main/leader session: report only in the final reply of your turn. Output per response is capped, so write long documents in parts (each tool call under about 300 lines) and keep the final reply short.

platform_notes.win32: On Windows never round-trip text files through PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content: they re-encode non-ASCII text on every pass.
